title: Meditation Impact on Resting Heart Rate
dataSources: Mood entries (`mood:entry`), meditation sessions (`meditation:session`), journal entries (`journal:entry`), gratitude logs (`gratitude:log`).
app: Mood, mindfulness and journaling apps — Daylio / How We Feel mood exports, Headspace / Insight Timer meditation logs, journaling and gratitude entries — sent to Splunk HEC via scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal (sourcetype=meditation:session OR sourcetype=hrv:reading)
| bin _time span=1d
| stats sum(eval(if(sourcetype=="meditation:session",minutes,0))) as med_min, avg(rmssd_ms) as hrv by _time
| eval meditated=if(med_min>0,"meditated","did not")
| stats avg(hrv) as avg_hrv by meditated
description: Compares your heart-rate variability on days you meditated versus days you did not, testing the calm you feel.
value: Linking meditation to a measurable recovery signal gives the practice objective backing beyond how it feels.
implementation: Join meditation minutes with HRV in `index=personal`; compare average HRV by whether you meditated.
visualization: Bar chart of average HRV on meditation versus non-meditation days.
grandmaExplanation: It compares a calmness heart-signal on days you meditated versus days you did not, testing whether it helps.
